description: EXPR-DOMAIN, deciding variants: all-Null input against no rows, expression errors and an absent criteria field in DSum. Dd2(id, g, v Currency) has g = 1 all Null, g = 2 one value and Nulls, g = 3 two values. Asks DSum, DCount and DAvg of v for g = 1, 2, 3 and 99, DSum without criteria, DSum('v * 2', ...), DSum('1/0', ...), DLookup with the absent criteria field nosuch = 1 and with an empty criteria string, each as its own SELECT ... FROM One. Follow-up probe (status F) for EXPR-DOMAIN; runs on a read-only open of fixture r-q-expr-sql-main through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
